title: İstanbul'un Kayıp Adası: Vordonisi
author: İpek Kobaner
description: A thousand years ago, İstanbul was shaken by one of the greatest disasters in its history: the earthquake of 1010. Amid the ruins, a young girl named Mara is given a second chance at life, but survival will demand courage, sacrifice, and the unraveling of secrets long hidden. Mara’s origins lie in a mysterious island; home to healers, oracles, and magical schools, that guards ancient wisdom and dangerous powers. From the shadows of the Middle Ages to the secret tunnels beneath Hagia Sophia, Mara embarks on a perilous journey where history and legend intertwine.
